items.title: Robinhood Stock Soars Thanks to Wall Street Upgrades, Platform Expansion
items.summary: Shares of  Robinhood  jumped 16.6% Thursday on a more favorable outlook for the company and after several analysts published positive reports about the brokerage firm’s stock in recent days.  Analysts from  Morgan Stanley  and Scotiabank upgraded Robinhood this week.  A  Piper Sandler  analyst raised his price target as well.
